items.name: Hide
items.description: Thick animal hide, crudely cured. Offers basic protection against claws and primitive weapons.

items.name: Leather
items.description: Hardened leather plates, offering a good balance of mobility and protection.

items.name: Quilted
items.description: A thick, padded garment that is surprisingly effective at absorbing impacts, but is somewhat bulky.

items.name: Light-duty vest
items.description: A modern ballistic-weave vest, easily concealed under clothing. Standard issue for corporate security.

items.name: CF short coat
items.description: A stylish carbon-fiber coat that provides excellent, discrete protection against modern firearms.

items.name: Chain mail
items.description: Interlocking metal rings, effective against slashing weapons but heavy and noisy.

items.name: Scale mail
items.description: Overlapping plates of metal, offering superior protection to chain mail at the cost of increased weight.

items.name: Plate mail
items.description: Full suit of articulated steel plates. Provides excellent protection but severely restricts movement.

items.name: Battle vest
items.description: A military-grade vest with ceramic inserts, designed to stop rifle rounds.

items.name: Battle jacket
items.description: Extends the protection of a battle vest to the arms and torso, with added gear webbing.

items.name: CF long coat
items.description: A full-length carbon-fiber duster, favored by freelancers for its blend of style and serious protection.

items.name: Attack armor
items.description: A rigid composite cuirass and pauldrons, offering frontline combat protection.

items.name: Cerametal armor
items.description: Advanced, custom-molded plates of a ceramic-metal alloy. The standard for elite soldiers.

items.name: Body tank
items.description: A massive, full-body enclosure of layered composites. Sacrifices all subtlety for maximum survivability.

items.name: Assault suit
items.description: An unsealed suit of powered armor with myomer bundles, granting enhanced strength and significant protection.

items.name: Battle suit
items.description: A fully-sealed suit of military powered armor, equipped with a basic life support system and heavy plating.

items.name: Commando suit
items.description: A lightweight, high-tech suit designed for special forces, featuring advanced sensors and stealth capabilities.

items.name: Mauler suit
items.description: A walking tank. The Mauler is the pinnacle of personal armor, capable of shrugging off heavy weapons fire.
